name: A 267-Concept Two-Row Transfer Obstruction
definition: Take the labelled $267$-concept cornerless ample forbidden seed $Y_{267}$. On coordinates $0,1$, flip coordinate $1$ and read the four rows $(B_0,D_0,D_1,B_1)$ of orders $(13,136,72,46)$.
parameters: $C=B_0\cup B_1=D_0\cap D_1$ has order $48$, $B_0\cap B_1$ has order $11$, the first-coordinate reduction $H$ has order $59$, and its contraction $K$ has order $208$.
properties: Both $H$ and $K$ are dismantlable ample, whereas the full two-row assembly $Y_{267}$ is ample and cornerless but not dismantlable ample. There are six unordered coordinate-pair presentations of this type. Its three reduction corners are not incident with the replaced coordinate; its two contraction corners lie over $C$ and fail the projected-cube compatibility test.
